secretariat.address: Kashim Ibrahim Road, P.M.B. 1124, Maiduguri, Borno State.

information.overview: North-eastern state with capital Maiduguri, known for the Kanem–Bornu historical legacy, Sahelian landscapes and Lake Chad Basin communities.
information.spokenLanguages: Kanuri, Hausa, Shuwa Arabic, Fulfulde and other local languages; English in formal contexts.
information.culturalHighlights: Shehu of Borno's royal institutions, Kanuri craftsmanship, historic trading culture and Islamic scholarship.
information.localFood: Tuwo, millet and sorghum dishes, masa, dried meat and regional stews.
information.weatherAndClimate: Sahelian hot dry conditions and a short rainy season, with harmattan dust in the cooler dry months. Rainfall and weather vary near the Lake Chad Basin.
information.transportOptions: Maiduguri has a major urban road network and airport; buses, taxis and tricycles serve the city. Movement outside the city may be restricted or unsafe and must not be inferred from a map.
information.travelSafetyNotes: High risk: UK FCDO regional advice lists the whole state under "against all travel" (checked 25 Oct 2026), reflecting risks including violent attack and kidnapping. This is foreign-government guidance, not an NYSC deployment instruction. NYSC advises daylight journeys, registered transport operators and notifying trusted contacts. Local conditions change: check your actual roads, transport hub and camp approach with NYSC before travel.
information.costOfLiving: May 2026 NBS Transport Fare Watch: average surveyed intracity bus fare in the state was approximately ₦1,511 per ride. This is a survey average, not a fare quote for the camp route. Accommodation and food budgets vary substantially by town, neighbourhood, PPA support and season; no defensible current state-wide monthly rent estimate was found. Ask current corps members for a dated local accommodation and food quote before paying.
information.placesToVisit: Shehu of Borno's Palace and Maiduguri cultural heritage; wider Lake Chad historic landscapes are not routine leisure destinations under current security concerns.
information.pcmTips: Verify the exact operating orientation venue shown on your call-up letter and the current NYSC security arrangements. Do not attempt self-directed travel to remote heritage sites or onward rural routes. NYSC cautions against night travel.

research.notes: Narrative is for orientation, not live route clearance or a financial quote. Attractions are descriptive, not security-verified recommendations. Languages and foods are examples, not exhaustive. Online community anecdotes are not used as verified safety facts.
